privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Enterprise Access & Data Protection Notice
privacy.overview_body: CISA Campus Work Tracker is an internal, access-gated organization application developed to facilitate campus ministry coordination, student onboarding, pastoral care, prayer tracking, gathering attendance, and collaborative workflows. Access is restricted to authorized team members and registered community participants.
privacy.data_intro: To provide secure authentication and internal functionality, the app collects:
privacy.data_account_creds_body: Email address, Firebase Auth user ID, profile photo, and display name (including Google OAuth sign-in).
privacy.data_member_profiles_body: Name, phone, email, university major, year, gender, pronouns, Instagram handle, spiritual background, journey stages, tags, and assigned stewards.
privacy.data_welcome_body: Contact info and fellowship interests submitted by prospective members.
privacy.data_pastoral_body: Interaction logs, pastoral visit reports, follow-up tasks, and photos uploaded to secure cloud storage.
privacy.data_prayer_body: Prayer burdens, personal prayer lists, and answered prayer celebration photos.
privacy.data_gatherings_body: Event schedules, check-in status (present/absent/late), and RSVP responses.
privacy.data_tasks_body: Action items, priorities, due dates, collaborative coordination notes, and board docs.
privacy.data_messaging_body: Direct, group, and announcement channel messages, reactions, and attachments.
privacy.data_diagnostics_body: Bug reports, user-agents, viewport sizes, and optional client-side screenshot diagnostics.
privacy.data_push_tokens_body: Expo Push / Web Push tokens for delivery of reminders and updates.
privacy.usage_body1: Collected data is processed strictly for enterprise authentication, access control, audit logging, and core workflow operations within your workspace. We do not sell, track, or share your data with third-party advertisers.
privacy.usage_body2: Server-side AI processing (e.g. Smart Import parsing of notes via Google Gemini API) operates strictly for real-time extraction and is not used to train public machine learning models.
privacy.roles_intro: Access is segregated into four role tiers:
privacy.roles_footer: Sensitive pastoral visit logs and administrative settings are restricted to Full-timers.
privacy.account_body: Accounts are provisioned by enterprise system administrators. Users requiring account modification or account data removal may request account deactivation through their corporate system administrator or by emailing
privacy.security_body: Access to stored workspace data is restricted to authorized system administrators and authenticated enterprise users. All data in transit is protected via TLS/HTTPS encryption.
privacy.contact_body: For privacy inquiries, data deletion requests, or technical support regarding this application, please contact our administrative team at
privacy.footer: Last Updated: August 2026 • CISA Campus Work Tracker Enterprise Privacy Policy

support.faq_access_title: How do I access my account?
support.faq_access_body: CISA Campus Work Tracker is an internal workspace app. Accounts are provisioned and approved by organization administrators. You can sign in using your corporate email and password or your verified Google account.
support.faq_roles_body: Access is categorized into four tiers: Full-timer (Admin), Trainee (Manager), Student (Operator), and Community (Viewer).
support.faq_notifications_body: Push notifications can be enabled or adjusted in your device settings under Settings → CISA Campus, or within User Preferences in the web app.
support.faq_deletion_title: How do I request account deletion?
support.faq_deletion_body: To request deletion of your account or personal data, email
support.compatibility_web_body: Modern versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge
support.footer: Last Updated: August 2026 • CISA Campus Work Tracker Support
